lessons.key: ac_gap::a thin facade layer s mocked call argument test does not substitute for a business logic test of the layer it delegates to test the layer that actually implements the acceptance criterion not just the layer that calls it
lessons.text: A thin facade layer's mocked call-argument test does not substitute for a business-logic test of the layer it delegates to - test the layer that actually implements the acceptance criterion, not just the layer that calls it.

lessons.key: ac_gap::a task s own completion note claiming a property is proven must be independently re derived by the verifier not trusted a presence check test on a pure parsing function does not prove a stateful dedup exactly once property
lessons.text: A task's own completion note claiming a property is proven must be independently re-derived by the Verifier, not trusted - a presence-check test on a pure parsing function does not prove a stateful dedup/exactly-once property.

lessons.key: gate_fail::every mockwebserver takerequest call must pass an explicit timeout timeunit argument an unbounded call is a live test hang risk even while currently passing
lessons.text: Every MockWebServer.takeRequest() call must pass an explicit (timeout, TimeUnit) argument - an unbounded call is a live test-hang risk even while currently passing.
